signal_to_trade_ratio.description: Signal-to-Trade Ratio: ~30% drop while WR improves >=5pp

max_dd_reduction.note: Requires rolling 30-day PnL time series; computed when enough daily data accumulates

data_coverage.enrichment_note: Picks need 'consensus_regime' and 'regime_alignment' fields at entry time. The regime_meta_router (score_picks_by_regime) adds these to active picks in the aggregator. For historical closed picks, 'regime_at_entry' from alpha_engine DB is used as fallback. Going forward, ensure all systems persist these fields when closing picks.
